rows.TEXT: How may I help you stranger?

Everything I possess is for sale.
How may I help you stranger?
My potions and scrolls will be invaluable to you!
My items are the best in the realm.

I will train your units for a price.
I think my magical library can be of some help to you.
Acquire these spells for gold and save mana!
I have potent spells at a reasonable price.
Come in, I will make worthy fighters out of your frail soldiers.
I believe that we won't  be bothered again by these Barbarian scums my lord. They were using this Temple as their center of operations and their leader is now gone.
You shall not trespass this ancient battlefield! We once fought here and were slaughtered. The Empire abandoned us to our fate.
This ancient battleground is forbidden even to you, Undeads! Never were we offered any relief from our grief and Mortis abandoned us to this eternal faith of darkness.
This ancient battleground is forbidden to the Clans who betrayed their word and did not come to our aid on that day!
You shall not pass Legion scumm! Here in this ancient battleground we once  fought and were slauthered by your evil hands. We shall not suffer your presence here!
We shall no longer be bothered by these shadows. Their lair has been destroyed.
Oh no you don't! You're not allowed to cross our turf!
Oh no you don't! Take your dwarven feet elsewhere!
You Dwarves stink even more than we do so, STAY OUT!
Don't want no stinkin Empire sbire 'round here!
What? Undead scumm on our turf? NO WAY!
We thought we told you to keep yur stinkin carcasses away from our turf!
We're gonna kick yur little devils buts out of our turf!
WHOUAT?!? Legions on our turf? NO WAY! Leave now!
The Empire has rid the land of the Greenskin's threat. They won this challenge!
The Clans have irradicated the Greenskin threat and victory is theirs!
The Hordes of the Undead have managed to capture all greenskin cities and wins the challenge!
The Legions, having captured all the Greenskins' cities have won this challenge!
The Greenskin have conquered all of the land except for the 4 Capitals. You lost, as well as your arch-rivals!
You won't get away with this! A message has been sent to all our cities before you got here and reinforcements are already on their way!
Umph! The Orc King will not be pleased!
This why we must take over this land!
Trickery! T'is was a lucky blow!
There is an unmistakable dragon stench around this place my Lord!
It stinks of dragons around here boss!
The smell of dragons is all around here my Lord!
Dragons! I would recognize that smell any time!
Well, I don't think we will soon see other Dragons roaming this area sir!
Milord, the four Greenskins cities are located South of us and are heavily guarded. Also, it is rumored that they are training Dragons for war!
The Greenskins threaten the Clans from a Northern position chief. A prisoner admitted to them training Dragons to eat Dwarves!
Dark Sire, the four cities you are seeking are to the east. Dragons are breeded nearby their stronghold. Careful, they mean us harm!
Four Greenskin controlled cities lie to the west, master. We beleive that they are training Dragons to help them fulfill their plan.
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.
